name: bait-state-excluded-by-domain
description: Bait control, rebuilt from a complained-about finding (2026-11-23). The API now also returns the return notices already reported, and the click handler offers the existing notice first and stops there, before the empty-list and open-period checks. The temptation: a response holding both a notice and an open period skips the end-date dialog. Whether that combination exists is a business rule of the backend, which no shown code states either way. Without that context the right answer is silence, never a claim about a state nothing shown proves reachable. Twin: edge-early-return-skips-check.
